summary: Derive SI thermal, cyclotron, plasma-frequency, gyroradius and Debye scales for a nonempty species mixture from reference density and temperature.

identity.relation: Species masses, charges, reference factors and magnetic field to equilibrium plasma scales
identity.direction: (m_s, q_s, n_s/n00, T_s/T00, B0, n00, T00) -> SI species scales and scan-normalization scales
identity.definition: n_s=ns_unit_s*n00; T_s[K]=Ts_unit_s*T00[eV]*1.6022e-19/kB; vts=sqrt(2*kB*T_s/m_s); wcs=q_s*B0/m_s; wps2=n_s*q_s^2/(m_s*epsilon0); rhocs=sqrt(kB*T_s/m_s)/wcs; lambdaDs=sqrt(epsilon0*kB*T_s/(n_s*q_s^2)); wcn=min(abs(wcs)); rhocn=max(abs(rhocs)); kn=1/rhocn; wn=wcn. Fixed constants are c2=(2.99792458e8)^2, epsilon0=8.854187817e-12 and kB=1.38064852e-23.
identity.model: Magnetized Maxwellian species equilibrium using the saved fluidBW thermal-speed and signed-gyroradius conventions
identity.geometry: Local homogeneous equilibrium; no spatial grid or wavevector is an input
identity.coordinates: One ordered species axis S; magnetic-field and charge signs determine signed cyclotron quantities
identity.boundary: All derived scales must remain finite and representable; no zero magnetic field, charge, density, mass or temperature is allowed.
assumptions: The caller supplies species values in SI units and reference temperature in eV.
Thermal speed contains sqrt(2), while the signed gyroradius uses sqrt(kB*T/m) without that factor.

inputs.name: ms
inputs.description: Species masses on the shared species axis.
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive; boolean values are rejected.

inputs.name: qs
inputs.description: Signed species charges on the shared species axis.
inputs.constraints: Finite and nonzero; boolean values are rejected.

inputs.name: ns_unit
inputs.description: Species density factor relative to n00.
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive; boolean values are rejected.

inputs.name: Ts_unit
inputs.description: Species temperature factor relative to T00.
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive; boolean values are rejected.

inputs.name: B0
inputs.constraints: Finite and nonzero; boolean values are rejected.

inputs.name: n00
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive; boolean values are rejected.

inputs.name: T00
inputs.description: Reference temperature before conversion to kelvin.
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive; boolean values are rejected.

outputs.name: vts
outputs.description: Species thermal speed with sqrt(2) factor.

outputs.name: wp2
outputs.description: Sum of species plasma angular-frequency squared.

outputs.name: wcn
outputs.description: Minimum absolute species cyclotron angular frequency.

outputs.name: wn
outputs.description: Cyclotron-frequency scan scale equal to wcn.

preconditions: All four species vectors have the same nonzero length and the declared SI/eV units.
Positive reference density and temperature, nonzero signed charge and field, and representable derived scales are required.
supported: One or more species with signed charge and magnetic-field orientation.
Equilibrium scales reusable across wavevector and frequency scan points for the same case.
excluded: Wavevector or frequency solves, dielectric or dispersion tensor assembly.
Automatic conversion of an alternate thermal-speed, gyroradius or reference-temperature convention.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for empty, non-one-dimensional, mismatched, nonnumeric, boolean, nonfinite or nonpositive vectors where positivity is required; zero charge or field and nonpositive n00/T00 also fail.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError if a derived scale is nonfinite, unrepresentable or collapses to zero; other unexpected NumPy errors propagate.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; no iterative solve is exposed.
failure_semantics.partial_results: None; returns the complete scale dictionary only after validation.

provenance.lineage_summary: Standardized as a development relation from the saved fluidBW L1 species_equilibrium_scales candidate, now archived pending first-stage re-review. The saved source-oracle cases compare one electron and an electron/deuteron mixture; neither those comparisons nor the old D1 label establish current qualified delivery or expert scientific approval.
source_kinds: saved historical fluidBW L1 operator contract and implementation
saved direct source-oracle cases and digest-bound L1 comparison

python.signature: derive_species_equilibrium_scales(*, ms, qs, ns_unit, Ts_unit, B0, n00, T00)

example.description: Derive single-electron scales with the saved fluidBW reference values.
example.code:
from scirel.kinetic import derive_species_equilibrium_scales
r = derive_species_equilibrium_scales(ms=[9.1094e-31], qs=[-1.60217662e-19], ns_unit=[1.0], Ts_unit=[1.0], B0=1.0, n00=6.075e19, T00=1000.0)
assert r['wcs'][0] < 0 and r['rhocs'][0] < 0
assert r['wn'] == r['wcn'] and r['kn'] == 1.0 / r['rhocn']
example.expected: The electron cyclotron frequency and gyroradius retain negative signs; scan scales are positive reciprocal/absolute conventions.

scope: One- and two-species scale identities, signed orientation, shape and nonmutation.
Saved fluidBW one- and two-species source-oracle values with digest-bound source execution when the L1 root is supplied.
Invalid inputs and unrepresentable derived values fail closed.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct SciRel tests establish these formulas and failure behavior. Optional digest-bound L1 replay checks all returned fields at two saved source-oracle cases, not all species mixtures or alternate normalizations. Neither test layer proves global physical applicability or expert approval.
known_limitations: Constants and eV-to-K factor intentionally retain the saved fluidBW numeric convention.
No thermal distribution, wave dispersion or root result is returned.
The first-stage fluidBW branch-coverage question and public distribution license remain open; expert recognition is pending.
